title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Veronika Erjavec and Martina Trevisan in the Buenos Aires, originally scheduled for November 26, 2026 at 10:00AM ET.
This market will resolve to "Veronika Erjavec" if Veronika Erjavec wins by 2 or more sets than Martina Trevisan, based on the final completed score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Martina Trevisan."
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the deciding set has begun when the match ends, Veronika Erjavec can no longer win by 2 or more sets, and this market will resolve to "Martina Trevisan."
If the match is canceled before play begins, or a result has not been determined by December 10, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official WTA Challenger results.
